<reason>CON won a close, high-quality clash by forcing the motion onto the actual instrument: a continent-wide interoperable digital gate, not identity in general. PRO never fully escaped that sleight of hand, while CON showed delivery gains were non-unique (headcounts, published payrolls, local proof) and used PRO’s junta concession plus fallbacks to argue surveillance arrives and cannot be bound, whereas analog exclusion can still be reformed. PRO’s exclusion-now and Union-scale mobility points stayed live, but CON’s irreversibility weighing and clearer alternative made the vote easier.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON’s Rebuttal 2: PRO admits the AU will not bind a junta, then offers purpose limits and human overrides; CON turns both into proof that the backbone is an unenforceable hunting tool whose ‘safeguards’ recreate the local nurse while making targeting instant and exportable.</best_rebuttal>
